description: Base Exclusions (Wind) for 2026-2027 IRP is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. This version of the base exclusions incorporates the latest draft version of the Protected Area Layer and the latest Techno-economic Exclusion layers for wind. The base exclusions form the fundamental exclusion set that the additional planning priorities of the Core Land Use Screen is added to. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are Busbar Mapping, CAOpenData, California Natural Resources Agency, IRP, TPP. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
